overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair deliberately kept the extra topics off the notice, so another member raising them at the reconvened meeting was not a violation. The location issue was declined as already decided in OML 2017-163.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that after the regular meeting the Board convened an unnoticed session and discussed topics not listed on the July 11 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Where the chair of a public body, or her agent, declines to add a topic to the meeting notice, it is not a violation of the Open Meeting Law when someone else introduces that topic at a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint about the Board moving its July 11 meeting to another room to meet concurrently with another committee was already decided in OML 2017-163, so not reviewed again.
